$comment: OpenID4VP 1.0 Final verifier plan against Inji Verify; format in conformance/plans/README.md. The suite plays the wallet. The client id is Inji Verify's response_uri with the redirect_uri prefix, and the request travels by value in the URL (url_query), so the suite reaches the presentation checks; the x509_san_dns configuration is verify.oid4vp-1final-verifier-x509-san-dns.json.

credential.$comment: Private JWK with x5c the suite signs the presented SD-JWT VC with. Inji Verify takes the issuer key from x5c, so no trust setup is needed.

authorization_request.$comment: redirect_uri:<response_uri>. Inji Verify accepts this client id only when the URI equals its own response_uri (measured 2026-10-14: the /v2/ path), and then returns the request by value.

review.$comment: Verdict Inji Verify must show for a module the suite ends in REVIEW: the presented credential is valid unless the module tampers with it.
